Frequently Asked Questions

How old is Jerry Stackhouse?

Jerry Stackhouse is 51 years old.

Where was Jerry Stackhouse born?

Jerry Stackhouse was born in Kinston, North Carolina.

When was Jerry Stackhouse born?

Jerry Stackhouse was born on November 5, 1974.

How tall is Jerry Stackhouse?

Jerry Stackhouse is 6-6 (198 cm) tall.

How much did Jerry Stackhouse weigh when playing?

Jerry Stackhouse weighed 218 lbs (98 kg) when playing.

Is Jerry Stackhouse in the Hall of Fame?

Jerry Stackhouse is not in the Hall of Fame.

When was Jerry Stackhouse drafted?

Jerry Stackhouse was drafted by Philadelphia 76ers, 1st round (3rd pick, 3rd overall), 1995 NBA Draft.

What position did Jerry Stackhouse play?

Shooting Guard and Small Forward.

When did Jerry Stackhouse retire?

Jerry Stackhouse last played in 2013.

What is Jerry Stackhouse's net worth?

Jerry Stackhouse made at least $84,406,843 playing professional basketball.

How much did Jerry Stackhouse make?

Jerry Stackhouse made $9,296,874 in 2007.

What did Jerry Stackhouse average?

Jerry Stackhouse averaged 16.9 points, 3.2 rebounds, and 3.3 assists per game.

How many rings does Jerry Stackhouse have?

Jerry Stackhouse won 0 championships.

What schools did Jerry Stackhouse attend?

Jerry Stackhouse attended Kinston in Kinston, North Carolina, Oak Hill Academy in Mouth of Wilson, Virginia and UNC.

What are Jerry Stackhouse's nicknames?

Stack, House are nicknames for Jerry Stackhouse.
